evidence: Source review, not a runtime measurement. Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions/ and assets/ from the environment/ build context, and :9-11 installs only express and better-sqlite3; no criteria, judge client, RewardKit, tests/ or solution/ enter it. environment/ holds only Dockerfile, six instruction notes and a 149-byte seed_data.json. A scan of instruction.md, environment/instructions/*.md and seed_data.json for judge/rubric/criteri/rewardkit/verifier/reward/score//tests//logs/openrouter/solution/oracle/golden found one unrelated hit (ui.md:13, syntax 'tokens'); none of the 52 criterion ids from tests/*/*/judge.toml appears in any agent-visible file. Verifier isolation: task.toml:28 environment_mode = "separate"; the key exists only as the ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template in [verifier.env] (task.toml:34). RewardKit, claude-code and the rubric are confined to tests/Dockerfile:16-17,31,43-44 (chmod -R go-rwx /tests). At grading, test.sh:3 umask 077, :11 chmod 700 on the log dir, :12 re-tightens /tests, :72-83 rejects symlinks escaping /app/node_modules, and :104-111 starts the submission with env -i (PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH only) under setpriv uid/gid 65534, so the submitted server cannot read /tests, the judge credentials or write reward files; the restart helper repeats the same launch (:160-167). Every dimension prompt.md:1 carries the untrusted-submission line and the scored prompts forbid shell use (functional prompt.md:27, polish :20, visual :21). environment/Dockerfile, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and tests/scoring.toml are byte-identical (ignoring CR) to the frozen template; task.toml differs only in identity/metadata lines 5-7 and 10-15. Not measured: no agent image was built and listed, and raw-evidence-index.json states the test.sh launch path (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH) was not run; the isolation claim rests on the frozen, template-identical source.
